scope: Exact ten-site control comparing the coarse Kronecker class sum T_coarse = sum M_i kron M_i with the coefficient-entry class sum T_entry = T_coarse R, where R swaps the column path pair. Both acts on the 1156-dimensional path-pair module. The spectra differ: T_coarse has generalized dimensions 441,225,490 at eigenvalues 0,1,2, while T_entry has dimensions 441,225,335,155 at eigenvalues 0,1,2,3. The published primary dimensions 34,1,225,300,35,406,155 split the coarse T=2 block as 335+155, matching T_entry. Therefore the twelve-site exact coarse T-primary dimensions 1485,3281,3155 are not automatically the coefficient-table T group dimensions; the twelve-site entry-convention spectrum remains open. No cut rank, two-cut pairing, or score change is claimed.
